name: Hacker News Algolia Search API
rate_limits: No published rate limits. Generous for reasonable use. Powered by Algolia infrastructure.
notes: Full-text search across all Hacker News content. No auth required. Key endpoints: /search?query=X for relevance-sorted results, /search_by_date?query=X for date-sorted results, /items/:id for item details, /users/:username for user profiles. Supports tag filters (story, comment, ask_hn, show_hn, job, author_X, story_X) with AND/OR logic. Returns full comment trees in single request. Complements the official HN Firebase API which has no search capability. Ideal for tech trend analysis, sentiment mining, and developer community intelligence.
